subject: Book Keeping
examFormat: Two papers taken at one sitting. Paper 1 has forty multiple-choice questions, all to be answered in 50 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 2 (2 hours) has Section A, Theory of Book-Keeping (four questions, answer two, 20 marks), and Section B, Practice of Book-Keeping (five questions, answer three, 60 marks).

subtopics.name: Meaning of Book Keeping
objectives: Define book keeping and state its history, nature, importance and functions
Identify career opportunities and beneficiaries of book keeping
State the qualities and values of book keepers

subtopics.name: Assets and Liabilities
objectives: Define assets and liabilities, state their differences, and classify them with examples

subtopics.name: Business Transactions
objectives: Explain the meaning and types of business transactions
Identify the parties involved in business transactions

subtopics.name: Classification of Accounts
objectives: Distinguish personal accounts (debtors and creditors) from impersonal accounts (real and nominal)

subtopics.name: Source Documents
objectives: Define, identify and state the types and uses of source documents

topics.name: Concepts and Conventions
objectives: Define and identify concepts and conventions and state the differences between them

topics.name: Books of Original Entry
objectives: Define books of original entry and state their purpose, types, format and uses
Prepare books of original entry

topics.name: Ledger and Principles of Double Entry

subtopics.name: Ledger
objectives: Define the ledger and state its classification, format and uses
Prepare ledgers

subtopics.name: Principles of Double Entry
objectives: Explain the meaning, history and rules of double entry
Make double entries

topics.name: Cash Book
objectives: Explain the meaning, purpose, description and differences of single column, double column, three column and petty cash books
Prepare single column, double column, three column and petty cash books

topics.name: Bank Reconciliation Statement
objectives: Explain the meaning and purpose of a bank reconciliation statement
Explain the terminologies and banking documents involved
State the causes of differences between the cash book and bank statement balances

topics.name: Trial Balance and Errors
objectives: Explain the meaning and functions of a trial balance
State the rules for and prepare a trial balance
Explain the meaning, types and classification of errors
Correct errors and prepare a Suspense Account

subtopics.name: Trading Account
objectives: Define the Trading Account and state its purpose and format
Prepare a simple Trading Account
State the methods of valuing stock (FIFO and LIFO)

subtopics.name: Profit and Loss Account
objectives: Define the Profit and Loss Account and state its purpose and format
Prepare a Profit and Loss Account

subtopics.name: Balance Sheet
objectives: Explain the meaning, content and format of a balance sheet
Prepare a simple balance sheet

subtopics.name: Adjustments for prepayments, accruals, depreciation, bad and doubtful debts
objectives: Make adjustments for prepayments, accruals, depreciation, bad and doubtful debts

subtopics.name: Meaning and methods of depreciation
objectives: Explain the meaning of depreciation and its methods (straight line and reducing balance)

topics.name: Control Accounts
objectives: Explain the meaning of Sales Ledger and Purchases Ledger Control Accounts and prepare them

topics.name: Single Entry and Incomplete Records
objectives: Explain the meaning and limitations of single entry and incomplete records
Prepare final accounts from incomplete records

topics.name: Accounts of Not-For-Profit Making Organizations
objectives: State the purpose and content of Receipts and Payments Accounts and Income and Expenditure Account
Prepare Receipts and Payments Accounts and Income and Expenditure Account

topics.name: Manufacturing Accounts
objectives: Explain the meaning, purpose and terminologies of manufacturing accounts
Prepare Manufacturing, Trading, Profit and Loss Accounts

topics.name: Partnership Accounts
objectives: Explain the meaning and terms of partnership: partnership deed, drawings, interest on capital, interest on drawings
Prepare Capital and Current Accounts, Profit and Loss and Appropriation Account and Balance Sheet
Account for the admission of new partners and prepare a Goodwill Account

topics.name: Joint Venture Accounts
objectives: Explain the meaning and purpose of joint venture
State the differences between joint venture and partnership

topics.name: Departmental and Branch Accounts
objectives: State the importance of and differences between departmental and branch accounts
Prepare Departmental and simple Branch Accounts

topics.name: Introduction to Company Accounts
objectives: Explain the formation and terminologies of companies
Prepare simple financial statements of a company

topics.name: Interpretation of Accounts
objectives: State the purpose of ratios and compute net profit margin, stock turnover, quick ratio, acid test ratio, gross profit margin and return on capital employed

topics.name: Purchase of Business
objectives: State the reasons for and terminologies of purchase and sale of business
Prepare accounts related to purchase and sale of business

topics.name: Consignment Accounts
objectives: Explain the terminologies of consignment
Prepare simple Consignment Accounts

topics.name: Hire Purchase
objectives: Explain the meaning of hire purchase
Prepare accounts in the seller's and hirer's books

topics.name: Contract Accounts
objectives: Explain the meaning, purpose and terminologies of contract accounts
Prepare Contract Accounts

topics.name: Cooperative Accounts
objectives: Explain the meaning and objectives of cooperative societies
